jurisdiction.authorityName: Ellis County Department of Development, On-Site Sewage Facilities

sourceReference: DRAFT profile, sources read 2026-10-06, from the Ellis County Department of Development's site (ellispermits.com), 30 TAC 285.7 and TCEQ's OSSF maintenance page. Ellis County's Septic Regulations and fee schedule are on elliscountytx.gov, which timed out on 2026-10-06, so they were not read. Ellis County publishes no way to submit maintenance reports. See docs/jurisdictions/tx-ellis-county.md.

requirementEffective.basis: Ellis County's Septic Regulations could not be read (elliscountytx.gov timed out on 2026-10-06), so their dates are unknown. Aerowise applies the ruleset from 2026-10-06, the day it was written.

sources.title: Ellis County Department of Development: Permits
sources.note: An aerobic permit needs 'design, tech form, soil evaluation, a filed affidavit, and an initial maintenance contract'. The OSSF Affidavit to the Public is filed with the County Clerk. Nothing on maintenance reports.

sources.title: Ellis County Department of Development: Links & FAQs
sources.note: Q7: a homeowner whose contract lapsed gets a letter; 'It is the homeowner's responsibility to ensure that contracts are submitted to the Department of Development.' Q8: repairs by a TCEQ-licensed installer or maintenance provider. No submission channel for reports or contracts.

sources.title: Ellis County Department of Development: Contact Us
sources.note: Department of Development 972-825-5200, dod@elliscountytx.gov (the department's general address; nothing says it takes maintenance reports); 302 N. Monroe St., Waxahachie, TX 75165.

sources.title: Ellis County Septic Regulations
sources.note: Could not be read: elliscountytx.gov timed out (also tried co.ellis.tx.us). Linked from https://www.ellispermits.com/regs.

sources.title: 30 TAC 285.7, Maintenance Requirements (Cornell LII)
sources.note: Last amended effective 2023-07-06. (d)(2): the owner provides a copy of the signed contract to the permitting authority 30 days before the service policy or contract expires. (e): reports to the permitting authority and owner within 14 days after the test; electronic monitoring allows two checks a year instead of four.

sources.title: TCEQ OSSF maintenance requirements
sources.note: Last modified 2026-03-03. Every four months, or six with an electronic monitor that notifies the provider of failures and monitors disinfection; reports within 14 days after the test.

unresolved: Ellis County publishes no way to submit maintenance inspection reports or contracts. The department's general email is not a published report channel, so inspection filings are held for review and contracts are filed by hand.

Ellis County's Septic Regulations and its Master Fee Schedule (effective 2023-09-01) are on elliscountytx.gov, which timed out on 2026-10-06. Any county-specific frequency, deadline, report contents, fees and dates are unknown; Aerowise follows TCEQ's 30 TAC 285.7 until they are read.
Which cities in Ellis County run their own OSSF program is not published; every site needs a reviewed assignment.
Ellis County publishes no acknowledgment of a received report or contract (it does mail lapse letters to homeowners).

applicability.howToDecide: The Ellis County Department of Development issues OSSF permits, but which cities run their own program is not published. Check with the Department of Development at 972-825-5200 that it holds the site's permit. Record what you checked.

inspectionReports.note: Ellis County publishes no way to submit maintenance inspection reports.

contracts.note: Ellis County's FAQ (read 2026-10-06): contracts are submitted to the Department of Development, with no channel published. Timing from 30 TAC 285.7(d)(2): 30 days before the service policy or current contract expires. Filed by hand.

monitored.note: 30 TAC 285.7(e) and TCEQ's maintenance page: twice a year with an electronic monitor that notifies the provider of failures and monitors disinfection. Ellis County's own regulations could not be read.

confirmation.note: Ellis County describes no reply to maintenance reports or contracts.
